svg.title: Background Tools: slow tools run while the agent keeps working
svg.desc: The model calls slow_research, a tool marked to run in the background. BackgroundTools answers at once with a started message and a task ID, so the model keeps working on other calls while the tool runs. When the tool finishes, its result arrives as a follow-up user message wrapped in a tool_result tag that names the tool and the call, and the next model request uses it. A normal run waits for its background tools before it ends.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
